_comment: Copy this file next to agent.py on EACH lab PC and edit the values below for that machine.
_secret_comment: Must exactly match PC_AGENT_SHARED_SECRET in the server's compulab/settings.py
_port_comment: Must match PC_AGENT_PORT in the server's settings.py
_server_url_comment: Base URL of the CompuLab Django server, used by the on-screen login form. For real lab PCs, this is the server's LAN address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000
lock_subtitle: Ilagay ang iyong Student ID at Reservation Code para magamit ang PC na ito.
